checks.reason: Vehicle or enzyme-only comparisons are insufficient: no complete positive product-recovery/negative/procedural control design with defined roles before collection.

A single physical site is not required by a hyperbolic competitive rate pattern; this asserted requirement conflicts with the correctly listed remote-site alternatives.
